identified_debt.remediation: Add a validated idempotency/retry-window guard that preserves the human approval gate and prevents duplicate review DMs without changing publication behavior.
identified_debt.reason_not_patched_live: A safe change requires validated full-workflow SDK reconstruction/testing; no high-blast-radius live mutation is justified during the W9 observation window.
